semiconductor_relevance: High — BBS Kinmei specializes in semiconductor wafer edge polishing technology, particularly for SiC and GaN materials.
summary: BBS Kinmei Co., Ltd. provides advanced equipment for polishing SiC and GaN wafers using proprietary technology that utilizes water alone. The company holds a leading market share in silicon wafer edge polishing machines and is recognized for its precision and throughput in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Proprietary SiC & GaN wafer edge polishing technology
